label: PLANET GS-4210-16P2S (hardware version 3)
description: PLANET GS-4210-16P2S managed Gigabit PoE+ switch (hardware version 3): 16x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (30 W a port), 2x 100/1000/2500BASE-X SFP uplinks, 240 W PoE budget, 42 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 31.2 Mpps, single-fan 1U.

poe.note: 240 W (max.) on the hardware version 3 datasheet. 802.3af/802.3at PSE, 30 W max a port at 54 V DC. The datasheet budgets 16 PDs at 7 W, 15 at 15.4 W and 8 at 30 W, so the 240 W budget - not 16 x 30 W - is the ceiling.

fabric.note: 42 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 31.2 Mpps at 64 bytes, 16K MAC table, 4.1 Mbit buffer, 12K jumbo frames.

notes: Hardware version 3 (datasheet v3.0 dated 2025-10-31). Ports 1-16 copper PoE+, cages 17-18 take 100/1000/2500BASE-X, RJ45 console at 115200 8-N-1, one fan, 440 x 207 x 44 mm, 2.3 kg, 293 W max fully loaded. Discrepancy: the GS-4210 Series Quick Installation Guide v1.11 still lists the 16P2S at 220 W, which is the earlier 100/1000 SFP hardware revision; the current v3 board carries 2.5G SFP cages and a 240 W budget, and that is what is modelled.
